causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages, at Tailem Bend to complete augmentation works on the Heywood Interconnector between Victoria and South Australia, materially reduced its capacity.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: While there is in the order of 1600 MW of wind capacity installed in South Australia, on the day it was generating around 240 MW, as forecast.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Two gas fired generators (Torrens Island B4, Dry Creek 3) were on planned outages and the return to service of Pelican Point power station was delayed by start-up issues which decreased the available capacity in South Australia.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The return to service of 240 MW at Pelican Point, which has commenced at around 3 pm, was delayed and only 60 MW was available.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Flows into South Australia on the Murraylink interconnector during the 6.30 pm trading interval were close to the 190 MW limit in the first three dispatch intervals and at that limit during the high price period.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Port Stanvac's FSIP specifies that they can start-up and reach their minimum load within five minutes, then once they have reached their minimum load, they must remain at that level for 15 minutes before being able to be targeted down.

constraints_named.quote: The V::S_TB_275kV_W_B1 constraint was invoked to manage the outage of the Tailem Bend West bus.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood Interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Planned network outages, at Tailem Bend to complete augmentation works on the Heywood Interconnector between Victoria and South Australia, materially reduced its capacity.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows into South Australia on the Murraylink interconnector during the 6.30 pm trading interval were close to the 190 MW limit in the first three dispatch intervals and at that limit during the high price period.

intervals.quote: On 14 July 2016 at 6.30 pm, the spot price for electricity reached $6918/MWh in South Australia.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding of capacity did not contribute to the price exceeding $5000/MWh.
